environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running migration-service in namespace 'platform-tools'. Service is exposed via ClusterIP service on port 8080. No network policies applied. Any pod in any namespace can reach the migration service endpoint. Istio sidecar is injected but running in PERMISSIVE mTLS mode with no AuthorizationPolicy resources defined. An attacker compromising any workload in the 'default' or 'app-tier' namespace can send concurrent POST requests to /migrate and /migrate/force to exploit the race condition, executing arbitrary SQL including GRANT statements or DDL that corrupts the schema.
